vibecare-http.comment: HTTP mode with mcp-remote proxy (RECOMMENDED). Get npx path with: which npx. Then run: just mcp-start-http-server

vibecare-embedded.comment: Embedded mode: MCP server runs with backend in single process. Run: just run-with-mcp YOUR_PROFILE_ID

vibecare-standalone-stdio.comment: STDIO mode: MCP server as separate process (legacy, may leave orphan processes)

vibecare-remote-http.comment: Remote HTTP mode: Connect to MCP server on remote host with mcp-remote proxy. Get npx path with: which npx
